newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AUSTRIAN BONDS RECOVER, MARKET SEEN EDGY.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRIAN BONDS RECOVER, MARKET SEEN EDGY.

text.p: Austrian bonds recovered from session lows to trade a tad firmer on Monday together with the German Bund future.
Traders said the market was very volatile ahead of the Bundesbank's tender decision tomorrow.
"The market is nervous. But now that the U.S. dollar has calmed down, no interest rate move is really expected," said one.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 steady at 99.15 to yield 5.74 pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.00/10 to yield 5.76/74 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 up 15 bps at 99.40 to yield 4.76 pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.26/34 to yield 4.80/78 percent.
* Austrian bond future down 14 bps at 109.02.
* 10-year spread over Germany down one at six bps, five-year lower at minus five after plus 18 on Friday.
* Money market rates three-month VIBOR unchanged at 3.450 and overnight money at 3.11/3.36. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
